questions.q_en: When a number is divided successively by 6, 11, and 14, we get the remainders 3, 4, and 5 respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 14, 11, and 6, we get the remainders A, B, and C respectively. Find the value of (A + B - C).
questions.solution_en:
Let the number is N, so when N is divided by 6, the remainder is 3. Let us say that the quotient is x. This x when divided by 11 leaves the remainder 4 and quotient y and when y is divided by 14, it leaves the remainder 5 and quotient z. This can be written as below:

N = 6x + 3... (1)

X = 11y + 4... (2)

y = 14z + 5... (3)

Putting equation (3) and (2),

X = 154z + 55 + 4 = 154z + 59... (4)

Putting equation (4) in (1),

N = 6 * (154z + 59) + 3 = 924z + 357.

Smallest such number is 357, when z = 0

Therefore, N = 357

Now, 357/14, quotient is 25 and remainder is 7.

25/11, the quotient is 2 and the remainder is 3.

2/6, the quotient is 0 and the remainder is 2.

So, A = 7, B = 3, and C = 2

Therefore, A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 10 - 2 = 8

Express Method

Let in the first condition, last quotient be 1.

So, dividend for 14 = 14 x 1 + 5 = 19

dividend for 11 = 11 x 19 + 4 = 213

dividend for 6 = 213 x 6 + 3 = 1281

So, the number is 1281.

Now,

(1281/14) = quotient = 25 and remainder(A) = 7

(25/11) = quotient = 2 and remainder(B) = 3

2/6 = remainder(C) = 2

Therefore,

A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 8

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statements is/are true?

Statement A: The unit digit of (1341 X 1718 X 1882) is 8.

Statement B: The unit digit of (2511! + 2312!) is 4.
questions.solution_en:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

For example:

21 = 2

22 = 4

23 = 8

24 = 16

25 = 32

After four consecutive powers, unit digit is repeated.

Hence, cyclicity of 2 is 4.

Similarly, we can calculate cyclicity of all the numbers as in the following table

Cyclicity Chart:

[Note: When, remainder is 0, power = cyclicity]

Statement A:

Unit digit of 1341 = unit digit of 341 = unit digit of 31 = 3

Unit digit of 1718 = Unit digit of 718 = Unit digit of 72 = 9

And, Unit digit of 1882 = Unit digit of 882 = Unit digit of 82 = 4

So, unit digit (1341 X 1718 X 1882) = unit digit of (3 X 9 X 4) = 8

Hence, statement A is true.

Statement B:

Unit digit of 2511! = 5

And, unit digit of 2312! = unit digit of 312! = unit digit of 34 = 1

So, unit digit of (2511! + 2312!) = 5 + 1 = 6

Hence, statement B is false.

questions.q_en: Find the unit digit in (423)75 X (867)54 + (295)63 X (712)91.
questions.solution_en:
• (423)75 → last digit 3; cycle of 3 is [3,9,7,1] => 75/4 = 3 (remainder) → 33 = 7

• (867)54 → last digit 7; cycle of 7 is [7,9,3,1] => 54/4 = 2 (remainder) → 72 = 9

• (295)63 → last digit 5; cycle of 5 is always 5

• (712)91 → last digit 2; cycle of 2 is [2,4,8,6] => 91/4 = 3 (remainder) → 23 = 8

• Unit digit = 7 * 9 + 5 * 8 = 3 + 0 = 3

I. The unit digit of the sum of the first 183 natural numbers is 6.

II. The unit digit of (213)329 X (189)282 X (517)511 is 9.

options_en: All of I, II and III

Sum of first 183 natural numbers = 183(183 + 1)/2 = 183*92

So, unit's digit will be 3*2 = 6

I is true

NumberCyclicity

Unit digit of 7511 = Unit digit of 74 X 127 + 3 = Unit digit of 73 = 3

So, Unit digit of (215)327 X (189)282 X (517)511

= 3 X 1 X 3

= 9

III.

2520 = 23 X 32 X 5 X 7

Number of odd factors = (2 + 1)(1 + 1)(1 + 1) = 3*2*2 = 12

questions.q_en: Anna and Ben each have a collection of marbles. If Anna gives one marble to Ben, they will both have an equal number of marbles. Conversely, if Ben gives one marble to Anna, she will end up with three times the number of marbles that Ben has. What is the total number of marbles they both have?
questions.solution_en:
Let Anna have A marbles and Ben have B marbles.

According to question,

A - 1 = B + 1.......(i)

A + 1 = 3(B - 1)........(ii)

From (i) :

A - 1 = B + 1

=> A = B + 2

From (ii) :

A + 1 = 3(B - 1)

Substitute A = B + 2 in the (ii):

(B + 2) + 1 = 3(B - 1)

=> B + 3 = 3B - 3

=> 6 = 2B

=> B = 3

Substitute B = 3 in A = B + 2:

A = 3 + 2

=> A = 5

Total number of marbles = A + B

Total number of marbles = 5 + 3

=> Total number of marbles = 8

Factor of 432 = 24 * 33

Factor of 360 = 23 * 32 * 5

Factor of 252 = 22 * 32 * 7

HCF = 4 * 9 = 36

Maximum number of kits = 36
